headline: The SCEP client can reach a CA through a forward proxy, with Basic authentication over an https proxy.
summary: Every pki.scep network verb accepts opts.proxy to reach an https CA through a forward proxy. pki.transport opens a CONNECT tunnel to the proxy and negotiates the origin TLS inside it under the identical origin trust policy, so the proxy relays the enrollment without being able to read it and cannot substitute the origin certificate. Basic proxy authentication (RFC 7617) is sent only over an https:// proxy, whose own certificate is verified, so the credentials ride an authenticated channel; a plaintext http:// proxy is tunnel-only, and supplying credentials for one is refused rather than exposing them to the proxy hop. Off by default, so the default client is a direct connection.

Added: pki.transport gains forward-proxy support: request.proxy = { url, auth?, tls? } opens a CONNECT tunnel to the proxy and negotiates the origin's TLS inside the tunnel under the same trust anchors and rejectUnauthorized as a direct connection, so the proxy relays the encrypted origin session without being able to read it and cannot substitute the origin certificate.

Basic proxy authentication (RFC 7617) is sent only over an https:// proxy, whose certificate is verified against proxy.tls (its own trust anchors, separate from the origin's), so credentials ride the authenticated TLS-to-proxy channel. A plaintext http:// proxy is tunnel-only; supplying auth for one is refused with transport/proxy-auth-requires-tls rather than exposing the credentials to the proxy hop. A proxy certificate that does not verify is transport/proxy-tls-failed.

pki.scep threads opts.proxy through every network verb (getCACaps, getCACert, getNextCACert, enroll, renew, getCert, getCrl). A malformed proxy option (scep/bad-proxy), a non-2xx CONNECT (scep/proxy-connect-failed), a 407 with no or rejected credentials (scep/proxy-auth-required, scep/proxy-auth-failed), and a plaintext-http origin (scep/insecure-url) each fail closed. Digest proxy authentication is not included in this release.
